ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: The fluke displays an approximate 40% high-intensity (white) to 60% low-intensity (black/dark-gray) pixel distribution, with high-intensity regions concentrated on the lateral lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white regions are mapped to the distal two-thirds of both lobes. The central peduncle zone is a contiguous low-intensity black region. High-frequency black-on-white mottling is observed at the interior boundaries of the white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A deep, symmetrical U-shaped median notch is visible with an estimated interior pixel angle of 45-50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The trailing edge is characterized by continuous irregular serrations with several high-amplitude, low-frequency peaks, particularly prominent along the superior-lateral edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Both lobes exhibit a mathematical convex sweep from the notch towards the tips, terminating in a sharp lateral taper.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Circular, high-contrast pixel clusters (consistent with barnacle attachment) are localized at the distal tips and along the anterior margins of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A dense network of multi-directional, low-intensity linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) is detected across the high-intensity white regions of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear scarring across both lobes and irregular, jagged topography on the upper-right trailing edge suggesting prior tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: A unique, dark vertically-oriented elliptical mark is located in the mid-ventral white region of the left lobe.
